name: Aitsu wa Houkago Yattekuru
original_name: あいつは放課後やってくる
source:
The leading male student Arata is confessed to by a strange man, but Arata refuses, saying that he will come again after school today and the suspicious person has left. 

It is rumored that the man is insanely dangerous.
